translations.web: A merchant has dishonest scales in his hand. He loves to defraud.
translations.bsb: A merchant loves to defraud with dishonest scales in his hands.
translations.kjv: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
translations.asv: He is a trafficker, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
